description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller for managing featured product items in an admin web interface. It includes endpoints to list, add, and remove featured items, interacting with product and relationship services, and handling AJAX requests for dynamic updates.

classes.name: FeaturedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing featured product items in admin panel.

methods.name: displayFeaturedItems
methods.description: Handles GET request to display featured items page, populates model with categories.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Returns paginated list of featured products as JSON, based on product relationships.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to featured items via AJAX, creating a ProductRelationship.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from featured items via AJAX, deleting a ProductRelationship.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets navigation menu context for the view.
